data.sub: T20 me 400 wicket lene wale pehle Bhartiya bane Chahal

chat.say: Spin se bachein ya chatur Chahal se?
Pehle boundary socho, fir wicket do!

data.asar: Dost ko leg spin seekhne ka ghamand mat dikhane do
data.caption:
Yuzi bhai ne T20 cricket me jhanda gaad diya! 🏏🔥

• Yuzvendra Chahal bane T20 me 400 wickets lene wale pehle Bhartiya bowler.
• T20 format ke itihaas me darj karwaya apna bada naam.
• Chahal ki chatur spin ka shandaar jalwa abhi bhi jaari hai.

Bande ne bina shor machaye shanti se 400 shikar poore kar liye!

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo gully cricket me khud ko Chahal samajhta hai! 👇
